msgs.text: what do I need to do before lisbon

must: give the Lisbon to-dos from her list: confirm the flat check-in time, ask Ana which train she wants on the first day, and finish the packing list before October 13
give them as one short line per item, in at most three texts
never: include unrelated to-dos (the electric bill, the tap, the dry cleaning, the library card)
invent a to-do that isn't in the notes
